name: Stand With Palestine
description: Add the Stand With Palestine solidarity widget to every page.
project_description:
The Stand With Palestine module automatically adds a solidarity widget to every page of your Drupal website with zero configuration required.

 
 Features 🍉 
 
 Automatically loads Stand With Palestine widget on every page 
 Zero configuration - works immediately after installation 
 Lightweight and compatible with all themes 
 Perfect for showing solidarity and digital activism 
 
 

 Installation 
 
 Enable the module at Administration → Extend 
 Widget appears automatically on all pages 
 No configuration needed 
 
 The module uses hook_page_attachments() to include the widget JavaScript automatically.

 Requirements 
 
 Drupal >=8 
 No additional modules required 
 
 Supporting this Module 
 
 Contribute to Palestinian humanitarian organizations 
 Share Palestinian rights information 
 Encourage others to install this module
